cap_confirmation: driver state level_cap 100; offset-1 members L99, Floette offset 2 L100 = cap+offset-2 on Medium.
chronology_note: Post-game after the Champion, pool-100 fully open; no gate-100 species used. One reachable legend (Chi-Yu, AshenWoods sign gate 48). See the manifest availability audit.
pre_play_strategy_checks: Liepard Prankster control opens (Fake Out/Taunt/Encore) and decides the player's first turn
Fezandipiti Tailwind or attack turn 1; Toxic Chain poison chance
Mesprit Helping Hand / Thunder Wave supports Mega Floette
Floette Mega Evolves and uses Calm Mind / Wish behind Protect
Incineroar Intimidate pivot with Parting Shot
Persian Fur Coat + Foul Play punish physical setup

attempts.why: Dark double lead (Incineroar + Chi-Yu) made Prankster Taunt/Encore useless; Liepard Fake Out flinched Chi-Yu t1 while Fezandipiti set Tailwind. AI withdrew Liepard for Incineroar t2 and Fezandipiti Protected the Heat Wave. t3 Overheat + Knock Off KO'd Fezandipiti (Moonblast left Chi-Yu at 19). t4 Chi-Yu out for Urshifu into Fake Out, Flare Blitz took Liepard to 73, Tailwind ended. t5 Surging Strikes OHKO'd Incineroar, Flare Blitz KO'd Liepard. t6 Close Combat OHKO'd Persian through Fur Coat, Mesprit Psychic KO'd Urshifu, crit Knock Off left Mesprit at 4. t7 Shadow Ball KO'd Mesprit; Mega Floette (Fairy Aura) + Helping Hand Moonblast OHKO'd Flutter Mane. t8 Floette Protected Fake Out + Flare Blitz; t9 Wood Hammer (neutral, terrain-boosted, 343) KO'd it. Faints: Urshifu, Flutter Mane.

strategy_checks.evidence: a1 t1 Fake Out flinched Chi-Yu; t5 Taunt on Urshifu (sensible, only Detect to lock). Status priority never attempted into the Dark leads - correct.

ai_notes: Withdrawing Liepard into two Dark types (t2) was the right read; bringing it back t4 for a second Fake Out was also good. Mega Floette Eternal shows ability FAIRY_AURA after transformation (Flower Veil is the base form's); dossier prose about Flower Veil only applies pre-Mega.
level_change_rationale: Won first try 6-2 after an 8-turn fight with two real KOs (Psychic on Urshifu, Helping Hand Moonblast on Flutter Mane). Keep.
cooler: The thief theme holds. The ace never got to Calm Mind because it Megas last against a field that is already 5-0; leading Floette + Mesprit (Fake Out immune via Covert Cloak) would let the Wish/Calm Mind plan actually appear. No set change recommended.
legality_notes: Sets legal; driver accepted both parties.
